newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Palamin copper output steady in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Palamin copper output steady in 1996.

text.p: Palabora Mining Ltd said on Thursday that copper concentrate production rose slightly in 1996 but cathode output was down.
Palamin produced 143,400 tonnes of copper in concentrates (141,700 in 1995) while cathode production was 104,300 tonnes (115,800). A total of 109,900 tonnes of copper cathodes were sold (114,400).
The company said that plans to take the mine underground were progressing well and full sinking operations were due to commence in May or June this year.
The group reported headline earnings per share of 1,483 cents against 1,307 previously.
